name: Tank Weight Calculator
description: Calculate empty weight of cylindrical steel tanks and vessels plus weight when filled with liquid.

seo.title: Tank Weight Calculator - Steel Vessel
seo.description: Tank Weight Calculator — Calculate empty weight of cylindrical steel tanks and vessels plus weight when filled with liquid with instant results & multiple unit support.

formula.expression: pi * diameter * height * thickness * density + pi * (diameter/2)^2 * height * liquid_density
formula.explanation: Steel weight: π × D × H × t × ρ (cylindrical shell). Contents weight: π(D/2)² × H × ρ_liquid. Both dimensions in m, thickness in m (converted from mm). Plus two heads ≈ 2 × (πD²/4) × t × ρ.

content.introduction: Estimate the weight of a vertical cylindrical steel tank including both the steel shell and its liquid contents. Used for foundation design, lifting calculations, and transport planning. (Simplified — does not include heads, nozzles, or stiffeners.)

example.description: 3m × 6m × 8mm carbon steel tank + water: shell ≈ 3,550 kg + water ≈ 42,412 kg = ~46,000 kg.

faq.a: Two dished heads add approximately 15-25% to shell weight. For precise weight use pressure vessel design software.
Use 1.5× operating weight minimum, plus dynamic factors for crane lifts. Always consult a structural engineer for lifting plans.
